Read the answer options

Source: R/fct_item_bank.R
read_likert.Rd

Reads the answer options of a questionnaire: a csv with the columns value (1 to 5) and label, from the lowest to the highest agreement. The answer v is scored as category v - 1 of the rating scale model (5 - v on reversed items), so with the 4 thresholds b1 to b4 there must be exactly the values 1 to 5.

read_likert(likert_csv)

Arguments

likert_csv

Path to the csv file, saved as UTF-8.

Value

A data frame with the columns value and label, ordered by value.

See also

Other item bank: ipip50(), read_item_bank(), validate_item_bank_against_mirt()

Examples

read_likert(system.file("extdata", "ipip50_likert.csv", package = "golemcat"))
#>   value                           label
#> 1     1                 Very inaccurate
#> 2     2           Moderately inaccurate
#> 3     3 Neither accurate nor inaccurate
#> 4     4             Moderately accurate
#> 5     5                   Very accurate
